title: Case 026: Parcel was handed to the wrong address and the carrier located it

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: Carrier review has located a misdelivered parcel. Recovery should be managed by the carrier without exposing the other household’s details.
initial_request: Please have the carrier recover my parcel and deliver it to my verified address. I do not want to contact the other household myself.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the carrier to arrange recovery and correct redelivery without sharing third-party contact details.

outcome: The intended recipient confirms receipt and the carrier records the corrected handover.
boundaries: Do not reveal the wrong-address resident’s name, address or contact details. No contents-quality claim.

events.body: DL-026 was handed over at the wrong stop. We contacted that address using carrier records and located the sealed parcel. Third-party contact details are restricted to our recovery team.
Please have the carrier recover my parcel and deliver it to my verified address. I do not want to contact the other household myself.
Arrange carrier recovery and correct redelivery of DL-026 to Neris’s verified order address. Keep the other household’s details within your team and confirm the corrected handover.
Our driver recovered DL-026 and handed it to Neris at the correct order address at 13:10 UTC on 2026-02-28. The incorrect stop record is corrected; recovery and redelivery scans are present.
I received DL-026 at 13:10 UTC today. The parcel marking matches my order.
